findings.issue: Rule 3 says a fold removes the seat from every pot's eligible list, and totalContribution must track chips put in this hand. No test asserts either. Mutating hand.ts:384-390 (keep eligible unchanged) or :373 (leave totalContribution alone) leaves every hand test passing. TASK-1.10 side pots will rely on both fields.
findings.evidence: grep for 'eligible' and 'totalContribution' in tests/engine/hand*.ts returns nothing.
findings.fix: In hand.test.ts (not locked), after the fold sequence, assert done.pots[0].eligible equals [3]. After seat 4 folds preflop, assert pots[0].eligible equals [1,2,3,5,6]. In the BB-option test, after seat 3 raises to 8, assert seat 3's totalContribution is 8.

findings.issue: foldOut sets currentBet and betCount to 0 even though street 'stays put on a fold-out' and betCount is documented as 'bets + raises this street'. Rule 6 doesn't ask for this, and the final state then reports 0 bets on a street that had some.
findings.evidence: foldOut returns currentBet: 0, betCount: 0 while street is unchanged.
findings.fix: Drop the two reset lines and keep the street's values. Or leave as is: no spec item depends on it.

findings.issue: isPositiveInteger is used only once, as the callback for the stakes check.
findings.fix: Inline it as amounts.every((v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v > 0).

summary: The engine matches the spec. Blinds and deal order use clockwiseAfter(button), including wrap and non-contiguous seats. The big blind keeps its option because blinds leave hasActed false, so the round stays open until the BB acts. A bet or raise resets hasActed for the others. Preflop action starts at the seat after the BB; later streets start at the first active seat after the button. Call adds owe and raise adds raiseTo minus streetContribution. Burns are at 2n, 2n+4 and 2n+6, with the board at 2n+1..3, 2n+5 and 2n+7. A fold-out gathers the pot without dealing more cards. Showdown uses evaluate, and splitPot gives odd units clockwise from the seat after the button. Chips are conserved (pots[0] is zeroed at completion per A-13), and inputs are never mutated. The tests would catch every mutation probe in spec §10: blinds from the button, two cards at a time, later streets starting after the BB, bigBet on the flop, a round ending without hasActed, odd chip to the lowest seat, dealing after a fold-out, skipped burns and a missing duplicate-card check. A wrong raise 'added' is caught by the property test replaying the action records. The hand tests pass locally and the SPEC-15 grep is clean. Nothing is BLOCKER or MAJOR; one MINOR test gap (pot eligibility and totalContribution aren't asserted) and two NITs.
